ترتهني (form VIII)
# تَرْتَهِنِي (tartahinī) /tar.ta.hi.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# تُرْتَهَنِي (turtahanī) /tur.ta.ha.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
